description: Local area walking and cycling in England is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. This statistical release presents statistics on the prevalence of walking and cycling amongst adults, at local authority level. It includes information on the frequency and purpose of walking and cycling. This publication is based on data from the Active People Survey run by Sport England. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. It offers 7 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2019-01-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
